title: Positive Berezin liminf does not imply essential positivity for radial Toeplitz operators on Bergman and Fock spaces
summary: We study whether essential positivity \[ σ_{\mathrm{ess}}(T_f)\subset [0,\infty) \] of a radial Toeplitz operator on Bergman and Fock spaces can be detected from the asymptotic behavior of its Berezin transform. For bounded real-valued radial symbols on $A^2(\mathbb{D})$, Perälä and Virtanen conjectured that \[ \liminf_{|z|\to 1^-} \widetilde{f}(z)\ge 0 \] should be equivalent to essential positivity, and they asked the analogous question on Fock space.
